comments.note: AC #3 FAIL: On macOS with system/global credential.helper=osxkeychain (default Homebrew git setup), GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 alone does NOT prevent git from hanging on a 401 HTTP response. Git invokes osxkeychain to resolve credentials, which can block indefinitely (tested: hang >6s with local 401 server). REPRO: spin up HTTP server returning 401, run git clone with env={GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT:'0'} only, observe hang. FIX: Add GIT_ASKPASS:'echo' to the env option in spawn(). With this, git calls 'echo' as the askpass binary (returns empty credentials immediately), bypassing osxkeychain entirely. VERIFIED: with {GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT:'0', GIT_ASKPASS:'echo'}, git fails fast (0.4s, exit 128) on the same 401 server. One-line change: env: { ...process.env, GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT: '0', GIT_ASKPASS: 'echo' }.

comments.note: src/git/git-cli.ts: GIT_ASKPASS='echo' instructs git to use a no-op credential program that immediately returns empty credentials, bypassing credential helpers like osxkeychain. This is the correct approach for non-interactive automation. The two env vars together (GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 + GIT_ASKPASS=echo) provide defence-in-depth: GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 suppresses prompt-based auth; GIT_ASKPASS=echo prevents credential-helper-based auth. Both are intentional.

src/git/git-cli.ts: GIT_ASKPASS='echo' causes git to submit empty credentials on the first auth challenge, resulting in an immediate 401 and exit. This is the desired behaviour for fail-fast, but should be noted in comments within the code so future maintainers understand why 'echo' is used and do not accidentally remove it or replace it with a real askpass binary path.

comments.note: A09 / Credential Exposure — Forward-looking concern for the credential-injection WP | src/git/git-cli.ts:141 (runGitOrThrow). When URL credential injection is added in a future WP (injectCredentials() wired into repository-orchestrator), git may echo the credentialed URL back in stderr (e.g., 'fatal: repository https://ghp_token@github.com/... not found'). The GitResult.stderr returned by runGitOrThrow() and runGit() would then contain the raw token. The future implementation WP must apply stripEmbeddedCredentials() to any error/stderr strings before they are surfaced in API responses, log output, or thrown Error messages. The utility already exists in src/git/git-credentials.ts.

A05 — Positive security control | src/git/git-cli.ts spawn() env option. The two-variable defence-in-depth (GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT:'0' + GIT_ASKPASS:'echo') is the correct approach for non-interactive git automation: GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT suppresses TTY prompts; GIT_ASKPASS:'echo' bypasses credential helpers (osxkeychain on macOS, libsecret on Linux, DPAPI on Windows) by substituting a no-op askpass binary. Together they guarantee fail-fast behaviour on unauthenticated clone attempts.

Platform note — Info | src/git/git-cli.ts GIT_ASKPASS:'echo'. On Windows, 'echo' is a CMD shell builtin and may not resolve as a standalone executable available on PATH when spawn uses shell:false. If Windows support is required, verify that git on Windows resolves 'echo' correctly (Portable Git and Git for Windows bundle 'echo.exe' in their bin/). No security impact but warrants platform testing.
